question: On the first automatically selected Target-522 snapshot, does the disjoint increment show broad agreement between recorded physical parent pointers and identifier-erased code similarity only when the real run/depth hierarchy is supplied, while rejecting structurally plausible wrong parents?
scientific_role: Forward structural quality certificate for the tree-native Decision Corpus; not a predictor-effect, search-utility, semantic-causality, or generic graph-reconstruction claim.

freeze_state.development_population_role: post-hoc method and threshold development only; may not be pooled with or rescue the disjoint forward increment

development_evidence_seen_before_freeze.known_result_interpretation: The flat similarity graph is not the physical parent graph, but run/depth-conditioned similarity strongly cross-validates recorded parents on the development population.

activation_rule.candidate: the exact immutable candidate in the completed hash-bound Target-522 selection package

primary_population.name: disjoint_forward_physical_run_increment
primary_population.membership: all endpoints in candidate provisional-first960 physical runs whose run_id is absent from snapshot 887

parent_recovery_estimands.eligible_edge: a recorded child-parent edge with both endpoints present in the disjoint increment and both fingerprints valid
parent_recovery_estimands.primary_candidate_set: all fingerprint-valid endpoints in the same physical run at exactly child.depth minus one
parent_recovery_estimands.primary_nontrivial_population: eligible edges whose primary candidate set contains at least two endpoints
parent_recovery_estimands.primary_success: the recorded parent is the unique maximum-Jaccard candidate; ties are failures
parent_recovery_estimands.uniform_random_control: mean exact 1 over candidate-set size on the same nontrivial population
parent_recovery_estimands.wrong_parent_control: enumerate every non-parent member of every primary candidate set; accept a proposed pointer only when it is the unique maximum-Jaccard candidate
parent_recovery_estimands.ablation_any_shallower_depth: all same-run fingerprint-valid endpoints with depth below the child
parent_recovery_estimands.ablation_same_run_without_depth: all other fingerprint-valid endpoints in the same physical run
parent_recovery_estimands.flat_pair_graph: all unordered within-run fingerprinted endpoint pairs; report fixed Jaccard 17/20 and same-population oracle maximum F1

classification_rule: Hard-gate failure takes precedence. If every hard, content-concordance, and hierarchy-complementarity gate passes, emit the strongest certificate. If hard and content gates pass but any complementarity gate fails, emit concordance-only. Otherwise emit below-strong-gate. Development values, any-shallower-depth results, cumulative candidate values, decimal displays, and alternative thresholds may not rescue a gate.

related_work_and_claim_boundary.allowed_if_strongest: On a disjoint automatically selected future increment, recorded physical parent pointers are broadly cross-validated by identifier-erased content only when run/depth hierarchy is supplied; the fixed audit also rejects structurally plausible wrong pointers at the pre-registered rate, while flat same-run similarity remains a distinct graph object.

failure_rule: Any selection, continuity, snapshot, append-only, hash, schema, fingerprint, depth, support, exact-arithmetic, security, reproducibility, or independent-verification mismatch fails closed. No same-candidate threshold, representation, population, tie rule, or interpretation repair is allowed.
